newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian rubber prices end down.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian rubber prices end down.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices fell at the close in a typically weak reaction to the start of a fresh trading week, dealers said.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted April RSS1 buyer at 293 cents ($) a kg, down 1.50 cents from Friday. April SMR20 buyer ended one cent lower at 277.50.
Trading houses quoted SMR CV at 348 cents, SMR L at 327, SMR 5 at 288, SMR 10 at 280, SMR 20 at 281 and latex at 235 cents.
No inquiries or sales were recorded for the day, said dealers at the houses.
"The market's weak as it is, and today being Monday was no better," said a trader.

The INRO five-day moving indicator was quoted at 226.13 Malaysian/Singaporean cents per kg on April 4, down from the 226.94 on April 3. The daily indicator also ended lower at 224.22 against 225.36 previously.
